model: Benshaw RediStart RB2 / RC2 / RX2E soft starter via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: Benshaw RediStart RB2, RC2 and RX2E solid-state soft starters on Modbus, read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the Benshaw RB2/RC2/RX2E: 307 objects (234 AI, 61 BI, 12 BO), 100 polled by default. Coils run/stop, reset faults and overloads, select local/remote and ramp, and drive the relays; inputs give ready, running, up-to-speed, alarm, fault and lockout states, input states, each alarm/fault code bit, currents, voltages, kW, kWh and the starter parameters (unpolled).
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Benshaw_Redistart_RB2_RC2_RX2E__LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the Benshaw RediStart Modbus register list (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/Benshaw.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 100 of the 307 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.
Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (Running Time; LCD Display Meter 1); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.

integration.summary: Set Local/Remote to remote, then run/stop by BO 1; read running, up to speed, average current and the alarm/fault/lockout states.
integration.enable: Starter Control Local/Remote (BO 4) selects whether the network run command is used; check the Benshaw manual for which state is remote.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
